# Teams Integration Guide

## 🤝 What Is Teams Integration?

The noobly Wiki integrates with **Microsoft Teams**, so you can access knowledge directly from Teams without opening a separate browser tab. This guide covers how to use the noobly Wiki within Teams.

## 📲 Accessing in Teams

### Installing the noobly Wiki App

1. Open **Microsoft Teams**
2. Click the **Apps** icon (bottom-left sidebar)
3. **Search** for "noobly Wiki" (or your organization's app name)
4. Click the app result
5. Click **"Add"** or **"Open"**
6. A new tab opens with the noobly Wiki

### The noobly Wiki Tab

Once installed, you'll see:
- **New tab** in your team or personal apps labeled "noobly Wiki"
- Click the tab anytime to access the noobly Wiki
- Your login carries over from Teams
- Same documents, same access permissions as the web version

## 🌐 Using the Tab

### Layout in Teams

The noobly Wiki in Teams works like the web version but optimized for the Teams interface:

```
Teams Navigation
  ├─ Left Sidebar: Spaces and Folders
  ├─ Main Area: Document View
  └─ Right Panel: Chat or Info
```

**Key differences from web:**
- No separate browser window needed
- Embedded directly in Teams
- Smaller screen space (optimize your layout)
- All features available

### Navigating Within Teams

1. **Browse spaces**: Click spaces in the left sidebar
2. **Open documents**: Click document titles
3. **Search**: Use the search box at the top
4. **Ask chat**: Use the AI chat panel (if enabled)
5. **Go back**: Click the back button or breadcrumb

## 💬 Commenting in Teams

### Adding Comments

Comments work the same as the web version:

1. Open a document in the noobly Wiki tab
2. Scroll to **Comments section**
3. Click **"Add Comment"**
4. Type your comment
5. Click **Post**

### Comment Notifications

When someone comments:
- You might see a **notification in Teams** (if enabled)
- Check the **activity feed** or the noobly Wiki tab
- Click to jump to that comment

### @ Mentions in Comments

Use **@mentions** to notify teammates:
1. In your comment, type `@` followed by a name
2. Select the person from the dropdown
3. They'll be notified when you post
4. Useful for asking for feedback or input

## 📌 Sharing Knowledge in Teams

### Sharing Documents in Chat

1. Open a document in the noobly Wiki tab
2. Click **Share** button
3. Copy the link
4. Paste in a **Teams chat or channel**
5. Your colleague can click the link to view the document

### Sharing Search Results

Found useful information?
1. Do a search in the noobly Wiki
2. Copy the URL from the browser bar (includes your search + filters)
3. Paste in a Teams chat: "Here's what I found about X"
4. Others can click to see your results

### Embedding Information

Some installations support **embedding documents or information**:
1. Look for an **Embed** or **Share** option on documents
2. Copy the embed code
3. Paste into Teams (if supported)
4. Document preview appears directly in chat

## 🔗 Teams Channel Integration (If Available)

Some organizations set up the noobly Wiki in specific Teams channels:

### Channel Tab

If your team has a noobly Wiki tab in a channel:
1. Click the **noobly Wiki tab**
2. Browse team-relevant documents
3. Comment and discuss right there
4. Others in the channel see the activity

### Channel-Specific Spaces

Some channels might show specific spaces:
- Project channel → Project documents
- Department channel → Department knowledge base
- Team channel → Team resources

Check your channel description to see if it's linked to specific spaces.

## 📞 Quick Access from Teams

### Pinning to Quick Access

Frequently visit the noobly Wiki?
1. **Right-click the tab** (if available)
2. Select **"Pin"** or **"Add to top"**
3. The tab moves higher in your sidebar for quick access

### Using the Search Box

1. Search from the noobly Wiki tab as usual
2. Your search is scoped to spaces you can access
3. Results work the same as the web version

## 🎯 Workflows with Teams

### Asking Questions in Chat

1. Someone asks a question in Teams chat
2. Another person replies: "Found it in the noobly Wiki"
3. Shares the link
4. Others can read the full answer without context switching

### Collaborating on Documents

1. Find a document that needs feedback
2. Share the link in a Teams channel
3. Team members open and comment
4. Feedback collected, document improved
5. No need for email threads

### Onboarding New Team Members

1. Create a learning path of documents in the noobly Wiki
2. Share the links in Teams
3. New person can learn at their own pace
4. Reduce onboarding burden on the team

## ⚙️ Teams-Specific Settings

### Notification Preferences

1. In Teams, go to **Settings** (gear icon)
2. Click **Notifications**
3. Look for **noobly Wiki** notifications
4. Set your preference (turn on/off, frequency, etc.)

### Default View in Teams

Some installations let you set:
- Default space or folder to show when opening the tab
- Default layout (detail, content, chat, search)
- Check your profile settings in the noobly Wiki

## 📱 Mobile Teams

### Using on Mobile

The noobly Wiki works on mobile Teams:
1. Open Teams app on your phone
2. Click the noobly Wiki tab
3. Browse, search, and read documents
4. Commenting works the same
5. Optimized for smaller screens

### Mobile Tips

- **Landscape mode**: Better for reading longer documents
- **Pinch to zoom**: Zoom in on diagrams or small text
- **Offline**: Some content might not load without internet
- **Download PDFs**: Use browser's download option for offline reading

## 🆘 Troubleshooting Teams Integration

| Problem | Solution |
|---------|----------|
| noobly Wiki tab is missing | Try installing the app again, or ask your administrator to enable it. |
| Can't log in in Teams | Check that you're logged into Teams with your work account. |
| Documents not loading | Check your internet connection. Try refreshing. |
| Comments aren't showing | The document might not have comments enabled, or you might not have permission. |
| Notifications not working | Check Teams notification settings and noobly Wiki settings in your profile. |
| Tab keeps jumping when switching | This is normal Teams behavior. Use pins to keep the tab visible. |
| Can't access certain documents | You might not have permission to that space. Contact your team lead. |

## ✅ Teams Integration Checklist

After this section, you should be able to:

- [ ] Find and open the noobly Wiki in Teams
- [ ] Browse documents within Teams
- [ ] Search for information without leaving Teams
- [ ] Comment on documents from Teams
- [ ] Share documents or search results in chat
- [ ] Ask questions in chat and have teammates link relevant docs
- [ ] Use Teams notifications to stay updated

## 💡 Best Practices

1. **Keep noobly Wiki open** in a pinned tab for quick access
2. **Share links in chat** instead of copying document text
3. **Comment for team discussion** instead of email threads
4. **Use @ mentions** to notify specific people
5. **Archive old searches** or pin frequently-used documents
6. **Encourage team discussion** in noobly Wiki comments
7. **Link related documents** so teammates can explore deeper

---

## 🔗 Comparing Web vs. Teams

| Feature | Web | Teams |
|---------|-----|-------|
| Browse & search | ✓ | ✓ |
| Read documents | ✓ | ✓ |
| Create documents | ✓ | Might be limited |
| Edit documents | ✓ | ✓ |
| Comment | ✓ | ✓ |
| Share links | ✓ | ✓ (easier) |
| Chat with AI | ✓ | ✓ (if enabled) |
| Full sidebar | ✓ | Compact |
| Screen real estate | Large | Limited |

**When to use web version:**
- Creating complex documents
- Detailed editing
- Managing multiple spaces
- When you need the full interface

**When to use Teams version:**
- Quick lookups
- Collaborating with teammates
- Discussing in context
- When you're already in Teams
